class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/Mission Command
class.description: Simple UI panel plugin for RViz for sending commands to UGVs.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/AVT-341 Autonomy Stack
class.description: UI panel plugin for RViz for the AVT-341 autonomy stack.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/Map Markers
class.description: Subscribes (latched) to an avt_341_msgs/MapMarkerList topic and lists each marker's id, x/y position and yaw in a table.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/NavGoal
class.description: Displays an avt_341_msgs/NavGoal as a pose arrow with the distance/yaw threshold region (the area in which the goal counts as reached).

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/NavGoalSequence
class.description: Displays an avt_341_msgs/NavGoalSequence as an ordered set of NavGoal visuals (pose arrow plus distance/yaw threshold region per goal).

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/MapMarker
class.description: Displays an avt_341_msgs/MapMarker as a flat ground decal: a thick ring with a heading arrow and the marker id in the centre.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/MapMarkerList
class.description: Displays an avt_341_msgs/MapMarkerList as a set of MapMarker decals (thick ring, heading arrow and centred id per marker).

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/StaticMapImage
class.description: Renders a static map image (.png/.pgm) read directly from a file path as a flat ground-plane map, visually identical to the built-in Map display. Resolution, origin and frame are set in the display properties (no topic required); width and height are taken from the image.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/Set Nav Goal
class.description: Tool for setting an avt_341_msgs/NavGoal pose (like the built-in 2D Goal Pose tool) with editable distance and yaw thresholds.

class.name: avt_341_rviz_plugins/Set Formation
class.description: Tool that publishes an avt_341_msgs/Communication FORM message, using the MapMarker clicked on the map as the formation objective. All other message fields are editable as tool properties.
